h: Fox News presenters Sean Hannity and Ainsley Earhardt reportedly marry in Florida
p: Fox News presenters Sean Hannity and Ainsley Earhardt have reportedly married in Florida after a pre-wedding party said to have been attended by Donald Trump. The couple announced their engagement in late 2024.
more: The pre-wedding party was reportedly attended by the US president.
The two have long been among Fox News's best-known faces.
